newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fil-Estate to invest in industrial estates.
newsitem.headline: Fil-Estate to invest in industrial estates.

text.p: Philippine property firm Fil-Estate Land Inc said on Monday it would venture into the industrial estate sector of the property business.
Fil-Estate said its wholly-owned Fil-Estate Properties Inc had entered into a land investment trust agreement to develop 100,754 square metres of land in Tanza, Cavite, south of Manila.
The development will form part of an industrial estate.

"With the economic prospects for 1997 remaining bullish, this venture also aims to take advantage of the continuous upswing in business and investments," Fil-Estate said in a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange. --Manila newsroom
